main_text.l: ROgamus autem] Sanctificationis pars octava:
Hoc autem officium quod hic commendat,
specialiter ministros verbi respicit: Praecipit e-
nim quid erga eos fieri debeat à grege. Fratres
eos compellat, quo innuit, praeceptionem hanc
ex fraterno & amico animo proficisci, atque ita
benevolentiam captat.

page.notes: Long s is printed as f throughout (e.g. "ficut", "fegnities", "filentio", "fpecialiter", "minifiros", "refpicit") and is transcribed as s. The first line is a fragment of "commendare" at the page top and is kept as printed. The large initial R of "Rogamus" is joined to the following word. The printed "Rogamus autem]" lemma is set as the opening of the paragraph and not as a heading. Hyphenated words at line ends are kept with their printed hyphen ("praeterea-tur", "desi-stendum"). The small marks at the right edge and a speck below the text are show-through or edge damage and are left out.
